Selected Commons file instead names Gaspar de Crayer, and external Bruges guide independently associates de Crayer's 1644 painting with the same church. Treat as TWO candidate paintings, do not transfer object 89062 to selected de Crayer image without geometric photo comparison.
reviewed.new_finding: Herregouts Vision of Thomas Aquinas BALaT 89062 is NOT yet photographically crosswalked to handpicked Gaspar de Crayer; the documented de Crayer church work and Herregouts catalogue record must remain distinct.
